cases.sentence: Вот лагеря на пути израилетян, когда они вышли из Египта по воинствам их под началом Моисея и ___.
cases.translation: These are the journeys of the children of Israel when they went out of the land of Egypt under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the conjunction 'и' (and) when listing paired items, continuing the construction 'под началом' (under the hand/command of).

cases.sentence: Израилетяне тронулись в путь из Раамсеса в пятнадцатый день первого месяца, в день после ___.
cases.translation: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month, on the day after Passover.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'после' (after) indicating time and sequence.

cases.sentence: Они выступили смело, на виду у египтян, хранивших первенцев, которых умертвил ___.
cases.translation: The Israelites went out with a high hand in the sight of the Egyptians who were burying their firstborn whom the Lord had struck.
cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject performing the action of striking the firstborn.

cases.sentence: Они покинули Сукот и остановились в Ятаме, на краю ___.
cases.translation: They traveled from Succoth and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'на' (on/at) in the phrase 'на краю' (on the edge of) to indicate location.

cases.sentence: Они покинули Елим и остановились у Красного ___.
cases.translation: They traveled from Elim and encamped by the Red Sea.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'у' (at/by) indicating proximity and location near.

cases.sentence: Они покинули пустыню Син и остановились в ___, на краю пустыни.
cases.translation: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin and encamped in Dophkah.
cases.explain: The prepositional case is used after the preposition 'в' (in) indicating location where they encamped.

cases.sentence: По повелению Господа священник Аарон поднялся на гору Ор и умер там в первый день пятого месяца, в сороковой год после того, как израилетяне ушли из ___.
cases.translation: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord and died there in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt.
cases.explain: The genitive case is used after the preposition 'из' (from/out of) indicating the origin and source of departure.

cases.sentence: Завладейте этой землей и поселитесь в ней, потому что я отдал эту землю вам во ___.
cases.translation: Take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given the land to you to possess it.
cases.explain: The accusative case is used after the preposition 'во' (into) indicating the direction and purpose of the action.

reading.ru: По повелению Господа Моисей записал лагеря на их пути.
reading.question: What did Moses do according to the Lord's command?
options: He built fortified cities for the tribes
He wrote down the record of the camps on their journey
He appointed judges for each tribe
He prepared the tabernacle for the wilderness
reading.correct: He wrote down the record of the camps on their journey
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'Моисей записал лагеря на их пути' (Moses wrote down the camps on their journey).

reading.ru: Они выступили смело, на виду у египтян, хранивших первенцев, которых умертвил Господь.
reading.question: What were the Egyptians doing when the Israelites departed?
options: They were preparing chariots to pursue Israel
They were burying their firstborn whom the Lord had struck
They were collecting treasures left by the Israelites
reading.correct: They were burying their firstborn whom the Lord had struck
reading.explain: The text says the Israelites went out 'на виду у египтян, хранивших первенцев, которых умертвил Господь' (in the sight of the Egyptians who were burying their firstborn whom the Lord had struck).

reading.ru: Пастбище для скота вокруг городов, которые вы дадите левитам, пусть простираются на тысячу локтей, вокруг городской стены.
reading.question: How far should the pasture lands extend around the cities given to the Levites?
reading.explain: The text specifies 'пасть простираются на тысячу локтей, вокруг городской стены' (the pasture lands shall extend one thousand cubits around the city wall).

reading.ru: Аарону было 123 года, когда он умер на горе Ор.
reading.question: How old was Aaron when he died on Mount Hor?
reading.explain: The text directly states 'Аарону было 123 года, когда он умер на горе Ор' (Aaron was 123 years old when he died on Mount Hor).

reading.ru: Когда вы перейдете через Иордан в Ханаан, то прогоните всех жителей этой земли, сокрушите их каменных и литых идолов и разорите их святилища на возвышенностях.
reading.question: What was the Lord commanding the Israelites to do regarding the inhabitants and religious structures of Canaan?
options: Make peace treaties with them and learn their ways
Enslave them and take their wealth
Drive out the inhabitants and destroy their idols and high places
Occupy the cities but tolerate their religious practices
reading.correct: Drive out the inhabitants and destroy their idols and high places
reading.explain: The Lord commanded them to 'прогоните всех жителей этой земли, сокрушите их каменных и литых идолов и разорите их святилища' (drive out all inhabitants, destroy their stone and molten idols, and demolish their high places).

reading.ru: Если вы не прогоните обитателей этой земли, то те, кому вы дадите остаться, станут у вас как шипы в глазах и колючки в боку.
reading.question: What warning did the Lord give if the Israelites failed to drive out the inhabitants?
options: They would lose their inheritance to other nations
The Lord would not protect them from their enemies
Those they allowed to remain would become thorns in their eyes and pricks in their sides
They would be forced to wander in the wilderness again
reading.correct: Those they allowed to remain would become thorns in their eyes and pricks in their sides
reading.explain: The text warns 'те, кому вы дадите остаться, станут у вас как шипы в глазах и колючки в боку' (those you let remain will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides).
